steps.quote: When a customer requests a replacement debit card (due to lost, stolen, damaged, or other reasons), the replacement policies vary based on the customer's checking account tier.

steps.do:
Check eligibility:
1. It is a checking account with status OPEN.
2. It has been open at least 3 business days (date_opened to today, excluding weekends).
3. The balance is at least $25 and covers the fees.
4. There is no ACTIVE or PENDING card on it.
5. The customer is at least 18, from date_of_birth.
6. The address is a US domestic address.
The tier comes from account_class: Entry (Light Blue, Light Green, Green Fee-Free), Mid (Blue, Green checking), Premium (Evergreen), Elite (Bluest).
Entry only: 48 hours must pass after the card closure, counted from the closure time recorded in closing_cancelling_a_debit_card (note_closure_time). If they have not passed, give the earliest order time (closure time + 48 hours) and stop.
If any other check fails, tell the customer what must be resolved and stop.

basis.quote: Debit cards can only be ordered for checking accounts (personal or business) - savings accounts are not eligible for debit cards.
Account status must be OPEN
Account must have been open for at least 3 business days (excluding weekends)
Account must have a minimum balance of $25 (to cover potential fees)
If the account has insufficient funds for delivery or design fees, the order will fail
Customer cannot have more than 1 active debit cards per checking account
Customer cannot have a pending debit card order for the same account (check debit_cards table for PENDING status)
Customer must be at least 18 years old (verify using date_of_birth)
Customer's address on file must be a valid US domestic address (international shipping is not available)
48-hour waiting period after card closure before a replacement can be ordered
No waiting period - can order immediately after closure
ENTRY TIER (Light Blue Account, Light Green Account, Green Fee-Free Account)
MID TIER (Blue Account, Green Account (checking))
PREMIUM TIER (Evergreen Account)
ELITE TIER (Bluest Account)

steps.do:
Compare the r1 count with the tier maximum per rolling 12 months: Entry 2, Mid 3, Premium 5, Elite unlimited. An account already at its maximum would exceed it with this card:
- Entry: wait, or pay $25.
- Mid: wait, or pay $15.
- Premium: must wait.
Otherwise excess_replacement_fee is 0. Where there is a choice, ask the customer.
- If they wait: give the date the oldest counted card ages out (its date_issued + 12 months). For Entry, give the later of that date and closure time + 48 hours. Order nothing.
- If they pay: carry the fee into order_card.
steps.quote: If customer has exceeded the 2-card limit, they must wait until oldest replacement ages out of the 12-month window, OR pay a $25 excess replacement fee

basis.quote: Maximum 2 replacement cards per rolling 12-month period
If customer has exceeded the 3-card limit, they must wait until oldest replacement ages out, OR pay a $15 excess replacement fee
If customer has exceeded the 5-card limit, they must wait until oldest replacement ages out (no fee option - must wait)
Unlimited replacement cards

steps.do:
Offer only the tier's options and fees.
Delivery:
- Entry: STANDARD $0 only.
- Mid: STANDARD $0 or EXPEDITED $15.
- Premium: STANDARD or EXPEDITED $0, RUSH $35.
- Elite: STANDARD, EXPEDITED and RUSH all $0; the card ships the same business day if ordered before 2pm EST.
Delivery times: STANDARD 7-10, EXPEDITED 3-5, RUSH 1-2 business days.
Design:
- Entry and Mid: CLASSIC $0, PREMIUM $10, CUSTOM $25.
- Premium: CLASSIC $0, PREMIUM $0, CUSTOM $15.
- Elite: all $0.
Tell the customer any fee is deducted from the checking account. Confirm the mailing address: the one on file, or another full US address, read back to them.
